messages:
sanjay: Origami-15b bring-up intake. Quick summary: differences in RoPE/rotary handling show up as KV-cache divergence between A100 and H100 builds. q4_0 quant appears to amplify repetition when eviction triggers. Need prioritization + a focused runtime compatibility checklist.

maria: Can you paste a minimal repro and the failing logs?

sanjay: Repro command i used: `runtest_kv --model origami-15b --shard a100:0 --seq 2048 --quant q4_0 --prefetch on`

Logs (snip):
```
2028-11-02T12:04:03Z [runtime] kv_cache: shard0 evict at token 1024
2028-11-02T12:04:03Z [runtime] rotary: apply_rotary prefetch true
2028-11-02T12:04:03Z [runtime] gen: token=1025 text="the the the"
```

On H100 the same run yields proper token diversity. A100 shows repeated tokens and a KV miss pattern.

kevin: Interesting. Did you try q8_0 on A100? q8 sometimes smooths this out.

sanjay: yes—q8_0 reduces repetition but increases mem. q4_0 is what our Dedicated customers want for cost.

eva: Could be an alignment issue with rotary indexing and our KV segmenter when eviction happens across shards. We saw similar on Emberstone but not exact.

maria: Let's make a checklist before we dig in: 1) deterministic repro on both HW, 2) confirm RoPE impl parity (float vs int kernels), 3) KV eviction unit test across shard boundaries, 4) quantized kernel precision sweep (q4_0/q4_1/q8_0), 5) eval regression vs baseline on evalset_small.

sanjay: +1 to checklist. I'll own 1 and 3.

kevin: i'll take 2 (compare kernel outputs). I will run `python -c "import torch; dump = runtime.compare_rope('origami-15b', device='a100'); print(dump[:5])"` and diff against h100.

infra-bot: Reminder: A100 test nodes scheduled maintenance today 14:00 UTC. Re-run early.

maria: For 4, try this quick sweep script: `./quant_sweep.sh origami-15b a100 h100 --modes q4_0,q4_1,q8_0 --seed 42` — capture token-level perplexity + repetition metric.

sanjay: Ran a smoke: q4_0 a100 vs h100 on 50 prompts: mean_redup a100=0.18, h100=0.05; perplexity delta negligible. Means it's generating same probs but sampling collapsed.

kevin: If probs same but sampling collapsed, could be RNG sync or softmax numerical edge-case (denormals). Check kernel math flags and fast-math compile flags.

eva: Also check KV indexing when sequence_len != cached_prefix_len. Eviction might leave stale pointers if we use relative indexing in rotary. I can write a unit test that forces staggered eviction.

maria: Priority rubric: (P0) Production-facing regressions or rollout blocker. (P1) Customer visible quality degradations. (P2) perf/cost improvements with risk. This looks P1 -> escalate if we see canary failures.

sanjay: Current customer canaries are green but we havent enabled q4_0 on Dedicated. So it's pre-rollout. Mark P1.

kevin: Timeline proposal: kernel parity diff + unit tests in 48h. If failing, schedule hotfix build for A100 runtime.

maria: Add eval harness: `eval_harness --model origami-15b --set onboarding_small --metrics rep_rate,perp,exact_match` and attach run id to thread.

ci-bot: CI status: nightly-runtime-tests passed on h100, failed 3/142 tests on a100 (kv_eviction_test, rotary_indexing_edge, quant_smoke_q4).

sanjay: I'll push the failing unit test logs to the repro gist and link here. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/origami-repro-1849998888

eva: Quick triage notes: probable root causes ranked: 1) rotary indexing off-by-one during cross-shard eviction, 2) quant dequant rounding causing denormals under q4, 3) async prefetch ordering race.

maria: Action items:
- sanjay: attach full repro and run kv_eviction_test with debug=1 (due EOD)
- kevin: produce kernel-diff artifacts and small numeric dump for first 2048 key/query vectors (48h)
- eva: add targeted unit that simulates eviction boundary and assert no stale pointers (24h)
- infra: reserve an A100 node for dedicated repro (ASAP)

sanjay: I'll also run the eval harness on q4_1 to see if it's a better tradeoff for Dedicated.

kevin: Ping me if you need a patched kernel build, i can produce a non-fastmath variant.

maria: Good plan. Let's reconvene in thread after ci-bot / unit tests update. If any canary fails we'll flip to P0 and notify SRE. :eyes: :clock1:

infra-bot: A100 node reserved: a100-dedicated-12 (expires in 6h).

sanjay: thanks — updating ticket INF-3821 and linking this thread.

maria: thx team. keeping this thread as the single source for the intake.

kevin: small note — include random seed and tokenizer version in every run. tokenizer v2.3 had subtle unk mapping change that once masked a similar issue.

sanjay: added seeds/tokenizer to gist. will paste unit logs when done.

maria: end-of-thread check: owners assigned, P1, repro + unit tests running. follow-ups due in 48h.
